pages.text: Kifaru Balanced Fund factsheet, issued by Nyota Asset Managers (SYN). Kifaru Balanced Fund is a balanced fund and its objective is to combine income and growth through a mix of bonds and shares. The management fee of Kifaru Balanced Fund is 2.3 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Kifaru Balanced Fund is SYN Sh 1,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 1,000. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Kifaru Balanced Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 7.6 percent.

Withdrawals from Kifaru Balanced Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Kifaru Balanced Fund are Treasury bonds (30 percent), corporate bonds (25 percent) and REIT units (10 percent). SYN Trust Company acts as trustee of Kifaru Balanced Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Kifaru Balanced Fund was launched in 2016 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall.
